purpose: Teach: タイガース/民謡/乗馬/蛍/扇風機/美容師/山間/山村

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、タイガースを応援に、球場通ったな。
lines.en: When I was younger, I used to go to the ballpark all the time to watch the Tigers.
lines.style: Gentle opening. Slow, measured pace. Voice travels inward—not performing memory, but touching it. Pause weight on 'ballpark' as if seeing it again.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。地元の民謡、祭りで毎年聴いてた。
lines.en: Mm. I remember hearing the local folk songs every year at the festivals.
lines.style: Quiet agreement. Warmth without effort. Soft smile in the voice. Slightly dreamy tempo, as if singing along in her head.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 乗馬を習ってた、隣の小川さん、覚えてる?
lines.en: You remember Ogawa from next door? The one who took riding lessons?
lines.style: Testing a shared memory gently. Slight lift of curiosity—wanting confirmation she remembers too. Pace unhurried, inviting her into the recollection.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 夏、川辺で蛍を二人で眺めた夜、忘れないわ。
lines.en: I'll never forget those summer nights by the river, watching the fireflies together.
lines.style: Tender, intimate delivery. Slows on 'fireflies'—lingers in that moment. Voice carries gratitude. Breathiness suggests emotion held steady, not spilled.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 扇風機、当時、贅沢品だったな。
lines.en: Fans were such a luxury back then, weren't they.
lines.style: Small smile in the voice. Wry observation without complaint. Short, matter-of-fact delivery with a trace of bemusement at how differently the world was.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 美容師の若い娘さんが、定期的に来てくれて、嬉しいわ。
lines.en: I'm so glad that young hairdresser comes to visit regularly.
lines.style: Quiet warmth, tinged with gentle surprise at kindness. Soft emphasis on 'regularly'—noticing the pattern, the care. Voice settles into gratitude without fanfare.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 故郷の山間の風景、今でも夢に出るよ。
lines.en: The mountain valleys back home—I still see them in my dreams sometimes.
lines.style: Distant, tender focus. Voice slows and softens. Slight pause before 'dreams' as if drifting there. Exhale carries the weight of longing held for decades.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 山村の春祭り、一度、帰省したいわね。
lines.en: I'd like to go back home once more for the spring festival in the village.
lines.style: Quiet yearning—not urgent or sad, but tender wish. Gentle pace. Voice trails slightly, as if speaking half to herself. Opens a door without demanding it be answered.
